1.zh: 论到从起初原有的生命之道，就是我们所听见、所看见、亲眼看过、亲手摸过的。（
1.en: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life

1.zh: 这生命已经显现出来，我们也看见过，现在又作见证，将原与父同在、且显现与我们那永远的生命传给你们。）
1.en: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);

1.zh: 我们将所看见、所听见的传给你们，使你们与我们相交。我们乃是与父并他儿子耶稣基督相交的。
1.en: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

1.zh: 我们将这些话写给你们，使你们的喜乐充足。
1.en: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.

1.zh: 神就是光，在他毫无黑暗。这是我们从主所听见、又报给你们的信息。
1.en: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

1.zh: 我们若说是与　神相交，却仍在黑暗里行，就是说谎话，不行真理了。
1.en: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.

1.zh: 我们若在光明中行，如同　神在光明中，就彼此相交，他儿子耶稣的血也洗净我们一切的罪。
1.en: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.

1.zh: 我们若说自己无罪，便是自欺，真理不在我们心里了。
1.en: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

1.zh: 我们若认自己的罪，　神是信实的，是公义的，必要赦免我们的罪，洗净我们一切的不义。
1.en: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

1.zh: 我们若说自己没有犯过罪，便是以　神为说谎的，他的道也不在我们心里了。
1.en: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

2.zh: 我小子们哪，我将这些话写给你们，是要叫你们不犯罪。若有人犯罪，在父那里我们有一位中保，就是那义者耶稣基督。
2.en: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

2.zh: 他为我们的罪作了挽回祭，不是单为我们的罪，也是为普天下人的罪。
2.en: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

2.zh: 我们若遵守他的诫命，就晓得是认识他。
2.en: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

2.zh: 人若说「我认识他」，却不遵守他的诫命，便是说谎话的，真理也不在他心里了。
2.en: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.

2.zh: 凡遵守主道的，爱　神的心在他里面实在是完全的。从此，我们知道我们是在主里面。
2.en: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:

2.zh: 人若说他住在主里面，就该自己照主所行的去行。
2.en: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

2.zh: 亲爱的[弟兄]啊，我写给你们的，不是一条新命令，乃是你们从起初所受的旧命令；这旧命令就是你们所听见的道。
2.en: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.

2.zh: 再者，我写给你们的，是一条新命令，在主是真的，在你们也是真的；因为黑暗渐渐过去，真光已经照耀。
2.en: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.

2.zh: 人若说自己在光明中，却恨他的弟兄，他到如今还是在黑暗里。
2.en: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.

2.zh: 爱弟兄的，就是住在光明中，在他并没有绊跌的缘由。
2.en: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.

2.zh: 惟独恨弟兄的，是在黑暗里，且在黑暗里行，也不知道往哪里去，因为黑暗叫他眼睛瞎了。
2.en: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

2.zh: 小子们哪，我写信给你们， 因为你们的罪借着主名得了赦免。
2.en: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

2.zh: 父老啊，我写信给你们， 因为你们认识那从起初原有的。 少年人哪，我写信给你们， 因为你们胜了那恶者。
2.en: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.

2.zh: 小子们哪，我曾写信给你们， 因为你们认识父。 父老啊，我曾写信给你们， 因为你们认识那从起初原有的。 少年人哪，我曾写信给你们； 因为你们刚强， 　神的道常存在你们心里； 你们也胜了那恶者。
2.en: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

2.zh: 不要爱世界和世界上的事。人若爱世界，爱父的心就不在他里面了。
2.en: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.

2.zh: 因为，凡世界上的事，就像肉体的情欲、眼目的情欲，并今生的骄傲，都不是从父来的，乃是从世界来的。
2.en: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.

2.zh: 这世界和其上的情欲都要过去，惟独遵行　神旨意的，是永远常存。
2.en: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.

2.zh: 小子们哪，如今是末时了。你们曾听见说，那敌基督的要来；现在已经有好些敌基督的出来了，从此我们就知道如今是末时了。
2.en: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.

2.zh: 他们从我们中间出去，却不是属我们的；若是属我们的，就必仍旧与我们同在；[他们出去]，显明都不是属我们的。
2.en: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

2.zh: 你们从那圣者受了[恩]膏，并且知道这一切的事。
2.en: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

2.zh: 我写信给你们，不是因你们不知道真理，正是因你们知道，并且知道没有虚谎是从真理出来的。
2.en: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

2.zh: 谁是说谎话的呢？不是那不认耶稣为基督的吗？不认父与子的，这就是敌基督的。
2.en: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.

2.zh: 凡不认子的，就没有父；认子的，连父也有了。
2.en: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.

2.zh: 论到你们，务要将那从起初所听见的，常存在心里。若将从起初所听见的存在心里，你们就必住在子里面，也必住在父里面。
2.en: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

2.zh: 主所应许我们的就是永生。
2.en: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

2.zh: 我将这些话写给你们，是指着那引诱你们的人说的。
2.en: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.

2.zh: 你们从主所受的[恩]膏常存在你们心里，并不用人教训你们，自有主的[恩]膏在凡事上教训你们。这[恩]膏是真的，不是假的；你们要按这[恩]膏的教训住在主里面。
2.en: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

2.zh: 小子们哪，你们要住在主里面。这样，他若显现，我们就可以坦然无惧；当他来的时候，在他面前也不至于惭愧。
2.en: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

2.zh: 你们若知道他是公义的，就知道凡行公义之人都是他所生的。
2.en: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.

3.zh: 你看父赐给我们是何等的慈爱，使我们得称为　神的儿女；我们也真是他的儿女。世人所以不认识我们，是因未曾认识他。
3.en: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

3.zh: 亲爱的[弟兄]啊，我们现在是　神的儿女，将来如何，还未显明；但我们知道，主若显现，我们必要像他，因为必得见他的真体。
3.en: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.

3.zh: 凡向他有这指望的，就洁净自己，像他洁净一样。
3.en: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

3.zh: 凡犯罪的，就是违背律法；违背律法就是罪。
3.en: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.

3.zh: 你们知道主曾显现，是要除掉人的罪，在他并没有罪。
3.en: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.

3.zh: 凡住在他里面的，就不犯罪；凡犯罪的，是未曾看见他，也未曾认识他。
3.en: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.

3.zh: 小子们哪，不要被人诱惑。行义的才是义人，正如主是义的一样。
3.en: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

3.zh: 犯罪的是属魔鬼，因为魔鬼从起初就犯罪。　神的儿子显现出来，为要除灭魔鬼的作为。
3.en: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.

3.zh: 凡从　神生的，就不犯罪，因　神的道存在他心里；他也不能犯罪，因为他是由　神生的。
3.en: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.

3.zh: 从此就显出谁是　神的儿女，谁是魔鬼的儿女。凡不行义的就不属　神，不爱弟兄的也是如此。
3.en: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.

3.zh: 我们应当彼此相爱。这就是你们从起初所听见的命令。
3.en: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—

3.zh: 不可像该隐；他是属那恶者，杀了他的兄弟。为什么杀了他呢？因自己的行为是恶的，兄弟的行为是善的。
3.en: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

3.zh: 弟兄们，世人若恨你们，不要以为希奇。
3.en: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

3.zh: 我们因为爱弟兄，就晓得是已经出死入生了。没有爱心的，仍住在死中。
3.en: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.

3.zh: 凡恨他弟兄的，就是杀人的；你们晓得凡杀人的，没有永生存在他里面。
3.en: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

3.zh: 主为我们舍命，我们从此就知道何为爱；我们也当为弟兄舍命。
3.en: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

3.zh: 凡有世上财物的，看见弟兄穷乏，却塞住怜恤的心，爱　神的心怎能存在他里面呢？
3.en: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?

3.zh: 小子们哪，我们相爱，不要只在言语和舌头上，总要在行为和诚实上。
3.en: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

3.zh: 从此就知道我们是属真理的，并且我们的心在　神面前可以安稳。
3.en: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,

3.zh: 我们的心若责备我们，　神比我们的心大，一切事没有不知道的。
3.en: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

3.zh: 亲爱的[弟兄]啊，我们的心若不责备我们，就可以向　神坦然无惧了。
3.en: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

3.zh: 并且我们一切所求的，就从他得着；因为我们遵守他的命令，行他所喜悦的事。
3.en: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

3.zh: 神的命令就是叫我们信他儿子耶稣基督的名，且照他所赐给我们的命令彼此相爱。
3.en: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.

3.zh: 遵守　神命令的，就住在　神里面，　神也住在他里面。我们所以知道　神住在我们里面是因他所赐给我们的[圣]灵。
3.en: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.

4.zh: 亲爱的[弟兄]啊，一切的灵，你们不可都信，总要试验那些灵是出于　神的不是，因为世上有许多假先知已经出来了。
4.en: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

4.zh: 凡灵认耶稣基督是成了肉身来的，就是出于　神的；从此你们可以认出　神的灵来。
4.en: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,

4.zh: 凡灵不认耶稣，就不是出于　神，这是那敌基督者的灵。你们从前听见他要来，现在已经在世上了。
4.en: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.

4.zh: 小子们哪，你们是属　神的，并且胜了他们；因为那在你们里面的，比那在世界上的更大。
4.en: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

4.zh: 他们是属世界的，所以论世界的事，世人也听从他们。
4.en: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.

4.zh: 我们是属　神的，认识　神的就听从我们；不属　神的就不听从我们。从此我们可以认出真理的灵和谬妄的灵来。
4.en: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

4.zh: 亲爱的[弟兄]啊，我们应当彼此相爱，因为爱是从　神来的。凡有爱心的，都是由　神而生，并且认识　神。
4.en: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

4.zh: 没有爱心的，就不认识　神，因为　神就是爱。
4.en: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

4.zh: 神差他独生子到世间来，使我们借着他得生，　神爱我们的心在此就显明了。
4.en: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.

4.zh: 不是我们爱　神，乃是　神爱我们，差他的儿子为我们的罪作了挽回祭，这就是爱了。
4.en: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

4.zh: 亲爱的[弟兄]啊，　神既是这样爱我们，我们也当彼此相爱。
4.en: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

4.zh: 从来没有人见过　神，我们若彼此相爱，　神就住在我们里面，爱他的心在我们里面得以完全了。
4.en: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

4.zh: 神将他的灵赐给我们，从此就知道我们是住在他里面，他也住在我们里面。
4.en: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

4.zh: 父差子作世人的救主；这是我们所看见且作见证的。
4.en: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.

4.zh: 凡认耶稣为　神儿子的，　神就住在他里面，他也住在　神里面。
4.en: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.

4.zh: 神爱我们的心，我们也知道也信。 　神就是爱；住在爱里面的，就是住在　神里面，　神也住在他里面。
4.en: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.

4.zh: 这样，爱在我们里面得以完全，我们就可以在审判的日子坦然无惧。因为他如何，我们在这世上也如何。
4.en: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.

4.zh: 爱里没有惧怕；爱既完全，就把惧怕除去。因为惧怕里含着刑罚，惧怕的人在爱里未得完全。
4.en: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

4.zh: 我们爱，因为　神先爱我们。
4.en: We love him, because he first loved us.

4.zh: 人若说「我爱　神」，却恨他的弟兄，就是说谎话的；不爱他所看见的弟兄，就不能爱没有看见的　神。
4.en: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

4.zh: 爱　神的，也当爱弟兄，这是我们从　神所受的命令。
4.en: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.

5.zh: 凡信耶稣是基督的，都是从　神而生，凡爱生他之　神的，也必爱从　神生的。
5.en: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.

5.zh: 我们若爱　神，又遵守他的诫命，从此就知道我们爱　神的儿女。
5.en: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.

5.zh: 我们遵守　神的诫命，这就是爱他了，并且他的诫命不是难守的。
5.en: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.

5.zh: 因为凡从　神生的，就胜过世界；使我们胜了世界的，就是我们的信心。
5.en: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.

5.zh: 胜过世界的是谁呢？不是那信耶稣是　神儿子的吗？
5.en: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

5.zh: 这借着水和血而来的，就是耶稣基督；不是单用水，乃是用水又用血，
5.en: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

5.zh: 并且有[圣]灵作见证，因为[圣]灵就是真理。
5.en: For there are three who testify:

5.zh: 作见证的原来有三：就是[圣]灵、水，与血，这三样也都归于一。
5.en: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.

5.zh: 我们既领受人的见证，　神的见证更该领受了，因　神的见证是为他儿子作的。
5.en: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.

5.zh: 信　神儿子的，就有这见证在他心里；不信　神的，就是将　神当作说谎的，因不信　神为他儿子作的见证。
5.en: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.

5.zh: 这见证就是　神赐给我们永生；这[永]生也是在他儿子里面。
5.en: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

5.zh: 人有了　[神的]儿子就有生命，没有　神的儿子就没有生命。
5.en: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.

5.zh: 我将这些话写给你们信奉　神儿子之名的人，要叫你们知道自己有永生。
5.en: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.

5.zh: 我们若照他的旨意求什么，他就听我们，这是我们向他所存坦然无惧的心。
5.en: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

5.zh: 既然知道他听我们一切所求的，就知道我们所求于他的，无不得着。
5.en: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

5.zh: 人若看见弟兄犯了不至于死的罪，就当为他祈求，　[神]必将生命赐给他；有至于死的罪，我不说当为这罪祈求。
5.en: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.

5.zh: 凡不义的事都是罪，也有不至于死的罪。
5.en: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.

5.zh: 我们知道凡从　神生的，必不犯罪，从　神生的，必保守自己，那恶者也就无法害他。
5.en: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.

5.zh: 我们知道，我们是属　神的，全世界都卧在那恶者手下。
5.en: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

5.zh: 我们也知道，　神的儿子已经来到，且将智慧赐给我们，使我们认识那位真实的，我们也在那位真实的里面，就是在他儿子耶稣基督里面。这是真神，也是永生。
5.en: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.

5.zh: 小子们哪，你们要自守，远避偶像！
5.en: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
